note: Third-party set dressing, sky and music of the museum scene. Only the listed files are in the repository; the downloaded packages stay outside it. None of them represents or is attributed to Kamëntsá or Inga culture; plants are neutral greenery with no species or use claimed.

assets.name: Wooden Lantern 01
assets.author: James Ray Cock
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2 collapse decimation to 20% (8321 to 1662 triangles), exported as FBX without textures. The 1k textures are copied unchanged; the ARM textures are not used.

assets.name: LowPoly Crops Pack (Corn_4)
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.derivation: One FBX file extracted unchanged from the package.

assets.name: Fern 02
assets.author: Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2: the four variants of the 1k glTF exported unchanged in shape to one FBX (meshes only, each with its origin at the centre of its base, named PlanterLeaves_1..4). Colour and OpenGL normal textures copied unchanged; the ARM texture is not used. Used for the planter plants of the arrival path and the courtyard, standing on the measured spots of the delivered stand-ins.

assets.name: Flower Empodium
assets.author: Jenelle van Heerden, Rico Cilliers
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2: the five variants exported to one FBX (meshes only, origin at the base, FlowerClump_1..5; 1 to 3 carry blooms). The red and white colour textures are copies of the original in which only the petal pixels were recoloured, keeping their shading; the yellow one is unchanged. Stands where the delivered flower heads were, in the three colours the delivery gives them.

assets.name: Kloppenheim 03 (Pure Sky)
assets.author: Greg Zaal (original), Jarod Guest (sky edits)
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2 (bundled numpy): the 4k HDR scaled so the median of the upper hemisphere maps to 0.32, an ACES filmic approximation (Narkowicz 2015) and sRGB encoding, saved as a 4096 x 2048 JPEG (quality 92). Chosen over farm_field_puresky and kloofendal_28d_misty_puresky for its broken cloud cover. It is a cloud panorama only, not a view of the Sibundoy valley.

assets.name: First Light Particles
assets.author: Yoiyami
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2 audio library: the 48 kHz stereo WAV (131.72 s) re-encoded to OGG Vorbis at 160 kbit/s, same length, nothing cut or mixed. Soft piano and synthesizer pads, no percussion and no instrument associated with a particular tradition. The author asks for no attribution and appreciates "Music by Yoiyami (CC0)". Looped in the museum with a 9 s crossfade.

assets.name: Tree Small 02
assets.author: Rico Cilliers
assets.derivation: Blender 5.2 (EEVEE, transparent film, one sun and a sky-coloured world): four orthographic renders of the 1k glTF from 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees packed 2 x 2 (forest_tree_cards, cards of the forest around the museum), and four close renders of parts of its crown with a ragged round alpha edge added, packed 2 x 2 (crown_leaf_cards, the crown of the tree of life, shrubs and the crowns of trees near the museum). The model itself is not in the repository.

assets.name: Brown Mud Rocks 01
assets.author: Rob Tuytel
assets.derivation: Colour texture copied unchanged. The bed of the welcome lagoon, seen through the water.

assets.name: Forrest Ground 01
assets.author: Rob Tuytel
assets.derivation: Colour texture copied unchanged. Leaf litter of the valley ground under the trees and at the foot of the walls.

assets.name: Planter Pot Clay
assets.author: Amal Kumar
assets.derivation: Only the colour texture is used, copied unchanged, wrapped round a light turned pot made in code (MuseumWorldDressing, about 200 triangles instead of the model's 3 080). Pots with a fern by the walls, hanging from the courtyard beams and at the door.
